Title: List a sample space
Learning intention: I am learning to identify every possible outcome of a single-stage event
Teaching support: A sample space lists all possible elementary outcomes without omissions or repeats.
Worked example: Tiles numbered 1 to 5 are in a bag and one is picked. List the sample space. Given: See the question text. Answer: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. The sample space lists every possible outcome once.
Reasoning example: A student listed the sample space for one pick as “blue, green, green, yellow”. Type the correct sample space. Given: The bag holds 1 blue, 2 green and 1 yellow counters. One counter is picked without looking. Answer: blue, green, yellow. The sample space lists each different outcome once, however many counters share that colour.
Application example: One letter card is picked at random from the word BANANA. List the sample space. Given: See the question text. Answer: B, A, N. List each different letter once.

Title: Identify a favourable event

Teaching support: An event is a set of outcomes. Check each outcome against the condition; the ones that fit are the favourable outcomes.
